title: Andruha Command Envelope v1
description: Base envelope for durable Kafka commands.

commandId.description: Unique identity of this logical command.

commandType.description: Versioned command type, for example message.send.v1.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the business payload contract.

issuedAt.description: UTC time when the command was issued.

producer.description: Stable service name of the command producer.

correlationId.description: Identifier of the complete cross-service operation.

causationId.description: Identifier of the request, command or event that directly caused this command.

payload.description: Versioned business payload defined by the concrete command contract.
